cohort: 3-year-old children with full primary dentition in China
finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of early childhood caries (ECC) in 3-year-old Chinese children.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was a risk factor for ECC in 3-year-old children (OR = 1.43, 95% CI = 1.10-2.83).
